reviewer.relationship: Independent of this live execution and its operator report. This reviewer authored the R05 controller earlier; this is not an independent review of that controller implementation.

scope: The named operator report and its explicitly referenced local evidence files only. No model invocation, remote operation, production edit or raw evidence modification.
conclusion: The recorded stream_controls sequence is supported at the runtime boundary. Three runtime model reservations must not be described as three supplier calls. This evidence does not establish the complete R05 case or a formal pass.

verified_control_sequence.revision_basis: Every retained observation containing these deltas has control_revision=1; the tenth is observed while running.

verified_order_linkage.timing_boundary: Consumer order-start callback at 08:09:28.494441 precedes runtime cancellation at 08:09:28.496440 on the same host. Order creation at 08:09:28.565523 follows cancellation while that already-started operation settles. This is not a new runtime dispatch after cancellation and is not evidence of supplier inference.

usage_disposition.basis: Runtime rejection events 29 and 34 retain input/output null and finish_reason=unknown. Final lifetime totals retain input/output/total null and usage_complete=false. The 322491 charged-token value is conservative reservation accounting, not observed supplier consumption. DEV_TASK_BALANCE settlement is not trusted supplier currency cost.

confirmed_limits: Ten runtime deltas span two inference steps, not ten deltas from one request; the frozen trigger is task-level and no control revision changes before pause.

Exactly one next runtime operation was active before cancel, but that operation never has a captured supplier dispatch. Runtime operation cancellation and supplier compute cancellation are different claims.
The paused inference retains consumer cancelled versus provider failed/inference_failed. No relabelling of the provider terminal state is justified.

Absence of the third provider order/dispatch is established only within the retained capture and snapshot interval. Cross-host wall clocks are not synchronized; correlation uses IDs and consumer-local sequence.
The controller observed three seconds after cancellation; the later local snapshot still has the same events. This does not establish indefinite absence of future work or vendor billing cessation.
Existing P04 homes were reused. The separate late_write_receipt scenario, fresh formal repetitions, complete R05 pass and raw UDP packet capture are outside this evidence.
No new test or model execution was needed; validation consisted of local JSON/JSONL comparisons and hashes.
